source_event.summary: Independent audit found a restrictive selected-scope requirement dropped by canonical extraction while a manual matrix entry masked the loss.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A canonical extractor can miss restrictive only-may language, while a manually retained downstream requirement makes saturation appear complete without source binding.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep a manually authored high-risk requirement after the canonical source obligation disappears and let the attack matrix validate only the retained entry.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Treat restrictive only-may syntax as a canonical obligation and derive authorization/isolation when it binds an authenticated actor to an active selected scope.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject attack-matrix requirements that do not map exactly to covered canonical obligations, including empty or mismatched obligation identifiers.

transfer_cases.scenario: A user-authenticated operation restricted to the active selected workspace must be extracted and classified as authorization plus tenant isolation.
A record mutation restricted to the active selected organization must remain canonically bound and cannot survive only as a manual downstream requirement.

skill_changes.evidence: Focused generic tests pass for restrictive scope extraction across vínculo, contrato, workspace and organização.
The validator now blocks orphan requirements and obligation-id drift; fast ecosystem suite passes 15/15.
